protocol_note: The Orin proxy has seven coefficients for each seven-point paper series. It is a saturated calibration replay and not the held-out test pre-registered in H2.

roofline_calibration.fit_provenance: Fig. 25 uses one four-coefficient bilinear surface for each 2x2 heatmap; Fig. 24 uses one seven-coefficient log-throughput surface for each seven-point operator series. The coefficients therefore interpolate their calibration anchors exactly and are not independent validation evidence.
roofline_calibration.name: paper-empirical-surfaces-v1
